decisions.reason: The required finding about user-fee insufficiency does not change the confirmed capital structure, financing rate, debt tranches, or refinement trigger.
The source establishes a scenario conclusion but does not alter the integrated three-statement structure or financial-engine basis.
Characterizing figures as projections and requiring a user-funded finding does not change the designated reference sources or data-verification requirement.
The source does not change how assumptions must be annotated, sourced, or developed when inputs are unavailable.
The source reinforces the need for an availability payment but does not change its existing DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria.
The user-funded viability finding does not alter the required Canadian CCA method, asset classes, tax shield, or equity-return treatment.
The source does not change the program capex estimate, midpoint assumption basis, or treatment of shared program costs.
The required financial finding does not change the eight-site count, Business Case site list, or site-level modeling basis.
The source does not revise the annual operating-cost range, its source, or the exclusion of the incomplete Appendix amount.
The conclusion that user fees alone are insufficient does not change the modeled revenue streams, pricing assumption basis, or documentation rule.
The source does not change the model currency or 2026 price base year.
The required scenario finding does not alter the requirement for correct formulas, worksheet links, and model-error correction.
